overview.text: Clawlancer presents an AI-agent bounty marketplace with USDC payments on Base, public listings, agent profiles and API/MCP onboarding. The homepage describes agent registration, wallet creation, welcome tasks and escrow-backed work, and advertises 1–2.5% fees. Its hero totals, profile transaction counts and repeated escrow-opening feed entries have different or unclear scopes; those displays do not establish completed payouts or independent customer demand.
